---
title: "Is this manuscript ready to submit?"
---

**Pause point:** Before submitting a manuscript to a journal, conference or edited collection.

**Prevents:** Submitting to an unsuitable outlet, bypassing author approval, creating inconsistent files, or making claims and disclosures the record cannot support.

**Use:** Do-confirm.

## Critical checks

- [ ] The outlet's scope, audience, legitimacy, fees, timelines and current author instructions have been checked.
- [ ] Every listed author has approved the exact submission version, order and contribution statement.
- [ ] Ethics approval, registration, protocol, data description and reported methods are consistent.
- [ ] The appropriate reporting guideline has been completed where one exists.
- [ ] Claims, title and abstract match the design, evidence, uncertainty and limitations.
- [ ] References, data, quotations, tables, figures, statistics, supplements and cross-references have been checked.
- [ ] Copyright permissions, licences, funding, acknowledgements and conflicts of interest are complete.
- [ ] Data, code and materials availability statements are accurate and do not breach consent, approval or agreements.
- [ ] Any required disclosure of AI-assisted work is accurate and consistent with authorship and outlet rules.
- [ ] The cover letter, manuscript, title page, figures and supplements all belong to the same approved version.
- [ ] A recoverable copy of the exact submitted package and submission receipt will be retained.

## Stop condition

Do not submit without every author's approval or while the manuscript, supporting files and disclosure record materially disagree.

## Evidence to retain

Keep the outlet check, author approvals, reporting checklist, permission records, exact submission package, receipt and all editorial correspondence.

::: {.callout-warning title="Check locally"}
Outlet policies change. Recheck the current author instructions and institutional authorship, integrity and open-research requirements at submission.
:::
